items.text: A mechanical engineer can switch to software testing or other IT roles by building programming and testing basics, showing a project, and using engineering strengths in analysis, documentation and systems thinking, but the move needs steady practice and realistic expectations about entry roles.
Start with testing or support roles where tools are learnable, build a small project and decide later whether to deepen in testing, automation or development.
Course placement claims are often exaggerated.
